circular or disc motifs on/near the torso
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces center an upright human-like body with a head above a torso and circular/body-band motifs integrated into the figure. The biggest difference is that A is a simple, schematic frontal torso-like figure, while B is a dense scene with an elaborately dressed standing figure, headdress, surrounding scrolls/serpent-like forms, and glyphic details not paralleled in A.
